reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis lacks a physically sound mechanism: adding 10 wt% of unspecified HEA particles to W–Cu is far more likely to reduce thermal conductivity (due to interfacial scattering and lower-conductivity inclusions) than to increase it by 15%, and spark plasma sintering at 300°C is far too low to consolidate W-based composites.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is vague (no specific HEA, no sintering details, no irradiation test) and the falsification criterion is logically flawed because it requires both no increase in conductivity AND degradation in properties to falsify, whereas a degradation alone would already disprove the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a physically implausible mechanism, ignores the critical irradiation-resistance requirement, and provides no actionable material or processing details for a researcher working on this problem.
